_comment: List prices in USD per million tokens, owned by the bench. The scorer prices every run from
its recorded token counts against this table; the cost_usd the runner wrote is kept in
runs.csv as cost_usd_runner and is not shown on the site. A run with tokens and no matching
row fails the scorer and the dataset gate, so adding a model means adding its row here.
Rows are matched by exact model id as it appears in runs/<id>.json models[]; the row with the
latest effective_from on or before the run's ts wins, so a price cut is a new row, never an
edit. Prices are the provider's published list price at the default route on the day pinned,
not what any contributor paid: discounts, credits and OpenRouter's upstream routing vary per
account and would make cost a property of the contributor instead of the run.
cost = (input_tokens * input + cached_tokens * cache_read + output_tokens * output) / 1e6.
input_tokens are exclusive of cache reads (the runner's ai_metering convention). cache_write
is recorded for completeness; no run carries cache-write counts yet.
